_meta.scope: Nakshatra, solar-month and vara-in-month festival rules: Masik Karthigai and Karthigai Deepam, Onam, and masaSystem-aware Shravan Somvar and Mangala Gauri.
_meta.yearLists: computeFestivalsForYear(year, location, {timezone, ...options}) must emit `key` on exactly `dates` in that year.
_meta.entries: `key` must be emitted on `date` (default options). `aloneWithinDays`: no other emission of the Karthigai keys within that many days. `ordinal`: the n-th emission of `key` in that calendar year.
